previous_attempt.text: Three training captures show OUT near IN with small bipolar residuals. Nominal and single R1 C1 variants all fail step worst region marginally while sine passes. Shunt R1 C1 are unobservable with measured IN conditioning. No consistent passive series or shunt change explains OUT above IN cases.
previous_attempt.note: The pair’s own restored rerun ended abstained: the drawing’s model missed the 0–5 ms region of both steps by 9.3 and 10.2 mV. The channel-timing model used from here on was qualified and published before this attempt.

display_caption: No mismatch in the tests Spark chose

photo.note: The mini board was not changed by the restoration: only the 20 kΩ resistor outside it was removed, so no new photo was taken. This is the original fault-state capture, shown as recorded; nothing was identified or read from it.
